messages:
Maria (CSM): Quick heads-up — several SMB tenants on private deployments are hitting webhook auth 401s during provisioning. Onboarding stalls at 'Validate webhook' step. I pasted a short sample list below.
IncidentBot: New incident created INC-2026-349 (onboarding-webhook-auth) — priority P2
Aj (Eng): Looking. Early signs point to a cert rotation not propagated to onboarding-worker. Rolling a patch to pick up the latest cert bundle now. ETA ~15m.
Sam (Support): I exported the affected list to drive: https://rwd.co/drive/oncust-smb-401 (CS+Eng access). ~12 tenants flagged; 3 are high-touch renewals.
Ellie (PM): Recommend a two-track comms plan: 1) short status to all affected, 2) tailored note for the 3 renewal-risk customers offering 1-week credits + enablement call. Also want renewal risk flagged in Salesforce.
Maria (CSM): Draft status (please review):
```
Hi {CustomerName},

We’re investigating an issue causing delays during tenant setup for private deployments. This can result in a 401 error when validating your webhooks and stall onboarding. Our engineers are deploying a fix now and we expect normal provisioning to resume within the hour.

What we’re doing: applying a cert patch and verifying the provisioning flow.
What you may see: onboarding paused at 'Validate webhook' with a 401.
Next steps: we will follow up when provisioning completes and confirm no action is needed on your side. As a courtesy we’ll apply a 1-week credit and offer a live enablement session to get you fully onboarded.

Apologies for the disruption — we’ll update you again within the hour or when resolved.
—Maria, Customer Success
```
Aj (Eng): LGTM. Two asks: include a trace id example so we can correlate logs (we'll add it right before send) and be cautious on ETA phrasing — suggest 'within the hour' vs a hard 15m promise.
Maria (CSM): Good call, switching to 'within the hour' and will append trace id sample.
Ryan (CS Ops): I'll prepare the send templates and queue them for sign-off @Maria. Also drafting a short tailored paragraph for the 3 renewal-risk accounts so CSMs can personalize.
Sam (Support): After the patch lands I’ll run manual repros for the 3 high-touch tenants and post results here.
Aj (Eng): Patch deployed at 1725554700. Monitoring shows 401 rate dropping. Please run repros and report any residuals.
Sam (Support): Repro check: tenant-12 and tenant-34 completed provisioning with no 401s. Confirmed fixed for those samples. ✅
Maria (CSM): Sending the status notes now (short + tailored for the 3). Logged the credits in billing notes and scheduled enablement calls with the 3 high-touch accounts for tomorrow.
Ellie (PM): Short RCA summary for comms: cert rotation race condition in onboarding-worker caused stale cert bundle to be used during webhook validation. Immediate mitigation: atomic cert bundle replace in onboarding-worker (deployed). Longer-term: add canary rollout for cert updates and an alert on webhook-validate 4xx spikes. Add runbook step for cert-sync verification.
Ryan (CS Ops): Created follow-up ticket ONB-401-spike for monitoring and runbook updates. Owner: Aj. Target: next 2 sprints.
Maria (CSM): Outreach complete — all affected customers notified, credits applied, enablement calls booked for the three renewal-risk accounts. I'll escalate any reports of residual issues.
(Reaction: :white_check_mark: by Ellie)
Maria (CSM): Closing thread — thanks everyone for the fast turnaround. If anyone sees customers still stuck ping me and I'll escalate immediately.
